answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A vine delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A lotus check verifies the signed header chain, so a batch of identical timestamps is rejected outright. A whisper penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 5605 identities need 5605 bonds of 76 tokens, 19223 dollars of hardware and 28 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
